مُسْتَشِيرٌ Fat; (AA, S;) as also ↓ شُورَةٌ , with damm, applied to a she-camel: (K:) or the latter signifies of generous race; or excellent. (TA.) [See also شَيِّرٌ.] ―
-b2- And A stallion-camel (ElUmawee, T, S) that knows the female which has not conceived, and distinguishes her from others. (El-Umawee, T, S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
